name: Adaptive Engineering
body:
Prerequisite(s): Tinkerer Class, Craft (any) 5 ranks

Benefit(s): Once per day, when activating an invention, you can swap one of its IP upgrades for another of equal or lesser IP cost that you know. This new configuration lasts until the invention is deactivated.
